extraction_meta.source: Harnessing protein language model for structure-based discovery of highly efficient and robust PET hydrolases
extraction_meta.authors: Banghao Wu, Bozitao Zhong, Lirong Zheng, Runye Huang, Shifeng Jiang, Mingchen Li, Liang Hong, Pan Tan
extraction_meta.constraints_applied: Extract PET hydrolase characterization data from the VenusMine paper; one record per enzyme characterized in the main text; kinetics from Table 1; figure-only values either null or kept as visual estimates with page-level sourcing
extraction_meta.anchor_note: anchor_title heuristic captured an abstract line ('Plastic waste, particularly polyethylene terephthalate (PET), presents sig-') on this two-column layout, so Level 1 auto-replaced source with it; per SKILL.md §2.2 the verbatim page-1 title prevails and has been restored here. The script's validation_report below keeps the original PARTIAL_FIXED record for transparency.

data.notes: Discovered by the VenusMine pipeline; highest PET degradation activity among wild-type PETases across 30-65 deg C; also 1.47-fold over LCC at LCC's optimum 65 deg C, and 1.15-fold when LCC runs in its optimal phosphate buffer (pH 8.0, 65 deg C) while KbPETase stays at 50 deg C; 1.5-fold higher kcat and 1.3-fold higher kcat/KM than LCC; GenBank WP_209642273.1; Table 1 SD: Km ±0.201 mM, kcat ±0.021 1/s, kcat/KM ±0.031 1/mM/s.

extraction_notes: Cohort-level results kept as notes rather than per-enzyme records: 34 candidates selected by VenusMine for wet-lab validation (Page 1); 26 of them successfully expressed and purified (Page 9); 14 showed PET degradation activity across 30-60 deg C with 11 of 14 comparable to IsPETase (Pages 1, 3); DSF Tm of the 14 ranged 36.4-80.1 deg C (Page 3).

Page 6 was classified skip_page by the smart page classifier although it carries Table 1 and the crystallography sentence; its text layer still served Level 3 numeric traceback, and Table 1 values are extracted with page-accurate sourcing (classification quirk disclosed).

Vision transcripts of Fig. 3c kinetics misread values and units (e.g. kcat/KM read as '4293 s-1 mM-1'); corrected against the text-layer Table 1 during merge, whose authoritative value is 0.263 mM-1 s-1.

Tm attribution for KbPETase: 80.1 deg C is the upper bound of the text-stated DSF range and is consistent with '+32.4 deg C over IsPETase' and the Fig. 2b/Fig. 3b visual readings (~81 deg C); Level 3 traceback marked it reliable because 80.1 appears in the text layer, and the attribution chain is documented in _source.
Fig. 3d product proportions (TPA/MHET) exist only as a figure; the text says only 'slightly higher proportion of TPA', so no numeric proportion was extracted.

Vision transcripts of page 2 and page 9 contained character-level misreads (e.g. 'VensMine', 'top 54 sequences' for the text-layer 'top 34'); all quoted numbers in this file were corrected against the text layer.
